card.name: Palm and sole body-part terms
card.fires_on: Negative pole on the middle of palm-and-sole words such as plantar, palmar and fundoscopic, and on 'of' after palm or soles. Seen in adverse reaction and dosing-instruction text.

modes.label: Plantar/palmar words
modes.description: Inside or just after plantar or palmar in reflex and hand-foot reaction terms.

modes.label: 'of' after palm or sole
modes.description: The word 'of' following palm or soles in application instructions.
modes.example: use the palm<< of>> the hand to apply testosterone gel 1

modes.label: Fundoscopic exam
modes.description: Middle of the word fundoscopic in eye exam instructions.
modes.example: perform fund<<oscopic>> examination before initiating treatment with SKYTRO
